record.question: In order to colour cosmetics, lotions and other preparations used for external use, which of the colouring agents is most commonly used?
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Mineral colour. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q6. Source limitation: Question lacks a product class and excludes common permitted synthetic color additives. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
